Method of Attack: Deployed as malicious IIS web server extensions to backdoor unpatched Microsoft Exchange servers with lower detection rates compared to web shells
Harvest credentials from system memory, collect information from victims' network and infected devices, deliver more payloads

Gain access to email mailboxes, run commands remotely, steal credentials and confidential data, perform Exchange management operations such as enumerating mailbox accounts and exporting mailboxes for exfiltration
Impacted Systems: public transportation companies in Southeast Asia and Europe
government and military organizations in Europe, Middle East, Asia, and Africa
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched security flaws in hosted apps leading to initial web shell deployment, followed by deployment of malicious IIS modules for persistent access
Exploitation of vulnerabilities in ZOHO ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus and SolarWinds Orion
